verses.1: Please, let there be a witness for you. And to whom should you turn for help?
verses.2: For the lion will kill the weak and destroy those who are jealous.
verses.3: I saw a wild boar, and I suddenly became afraid.
verses.4: Let their sons be driven away from Yeshua; let them suffer in the streets, with no one to save them.
verses.5: Whoever has a hungry stomach will eat, and whoever is thirsty will drink.
verses.6: For from the dust of the earth, no one can arise to become a person.
verses.7: For man, through toil, becomes young; and sons of the king will bear him up.
verses.8: But I desire to go to God and to Him alone. I will speak only to Him.
verses.9: He does great things, but there’s no knowledge of their wonders. There’s no end to them.
verses.10: He causes rain to fall upon the earth, and he sends water over the hills.
verses.11: Let them be humiliated in shame, and let their proudness be brought down.
verses.12: Let their thoughts be like those of wild animals; let them not do what they desire. Their hands will be in chaos.
verses.13: Let us seek wise men in their midst, and let the counsel of those who are capable be utilized quickly.
verses.14: By day, darkness will cover them; by night, darkness will reign over them.
verses.15: And he was saved from their hands, and from the power of Ebon.
verses.16: And it became a place of prayer and worship.
verses.17: Now, human beings must acknowledge God’s existence, and they must also take care not to waste their lives in vain.
verses.18: For he will cause suffering and pain; his hands will be broken, and his arms will be torn apart.
verses.19: In six trials, He will save you; and in seven trials, He will not harm you.
verses.20: In hunger, you are saved from death; in war, you are saved from destruction.
verses.21: In the darkness, it will be hidden away, and it will not be afraid of anything that comes.
verses.22: For the devil and his demons will play their games, but do not be afraid from the life of the earth.
verses.23: For with the stones of the field are your covenant and the life of the field that is complete for you.
verses.24: And you shall know that peace is with you. You will be protected, and you will not sin.
verses.25: And you shall know that your descendants and children are like the plants of the earth.
verses.26: It comes upon Elie-Kaver in all its glory, like a majestic figure at that moment.
verses.27: Now, this is what we have learned. It is a thing that can be heard; and you must know this.
